title: 5th Special Forces Group (Airborne) — Operational Report / Lessons Learned, period ending 31 December 1967
citation: 5th Special Forces Group (Airborne), 1st Special Forces, Operational Report - Lessons Learned for the period ending 31 December 1967, dated 12 August 1968, 203 pp. Bud Harton Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 168300010050.
notes: Two years later than Larry's tour, but a model of the record type: its annexes tabulate every Special Forces team in the group with its commander, camp, province, grid coordinate, the make-up of its strike force, and a per-camp code word. Nui Ba Den appears with its grid among the III Corps camps. The 1965 equivalent of this report, if it survives, would give the same for Larry's year; it has not yet been requested.
